# F4 (part B): The one-shot holdout

*Generated by `python -m forecast.render_f4_holdout` from `results/f4_holdout.json` and
`results/f4_backtest.json`. Do not edit the numbers by hand.*

## What this step does, in plain words

Part A chose and froze the model using only the backtest windows. This step tests that frozen model
once on the last {n_days} days of the data, d_{first_d}..d_{last_d} ({first_date} to {last_date}).
Nothing before had read, scored or tuned on those days. The model and every F3 baseline forecast from
the same day (d_{origin}) with the same metrics, so the result shows how they do on genuinely new data.

**Headline:** {headline}

{best_text}

## How it was run

- **From a frozen commit.** `python -m forecast.run_f4_holdout` ran once, from commit `{commit}`
  (`{commit_full}`), started {started}. It refuses to run if the git tree is not clean, and refuses
  a second run because `results/f4_holdout.json` now exists.
- **The frozen model.** Setting {chosen}: {leaves} leaves, learning rate {lr}, at least {min_leaf}
  rows per leaf, {rounds} trees. These come from `config/model_final.yaml`, chosen on the backtest
  only. It was trained on {training_rows} rows, all with target days up to d_{origin}, and forecasts
  d_{first_d}..d_{last_d} from d_{origin}. The run took {run_minutes} min.
- **What was scored.** {n_scored} of {n_series} series ({scored_days} listed series-days); at the
  origin: {classes}. Unlisted days are not scored, as in F3.

## 6. Limits of this test

- **One window.** The holdout is a single 28-day period from one origin ({first_date} to {last_date}). The
  backtest's 4 origins show how much results move between windows; one holdout window cannot.
- **Item-store level only.** WRMSSE here averages item-store series only (as in F3). It is not the
  M5 leaderboard score, which also averages 11 aggregate levels.
- **Simulated use, not deployment.** The model forecasts once from a fixed day. A store would
  re-forecast as new days arrive.

## 7. Handed to F5

Forecasts, actuals and residuals (actual − forecast) per series, horizon and method on the holdout
({f5_rows} rows) are in `{f5_file}` (gitignored; per-item data is not redistributed). The backtest
residuals from part A are next to them, for sizing safety stock without using the holdout.
